verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA software stack (bundled as part of the Ryzen AI ecosystem) includes an Agent Framework with tool orchestration, state management, and error recovery, plus a plugin system to distribute agents and local inference for air-gapped/background operation, which supports building autonomous agents on this hardware. However, there is no explicit evidence of scheduled/background automation triggers or persistent unattended execution—the docs describe agent building blocks and a desktop chat UI rather than a documented 'runs autonomously in background' automation feature. Missing for 10: explicit background/scheduled task execution, evidence of unattended multi-step automation runs, and independent hands-on confirmation of autonomous operation.
